observations: I opened assets/panels/01-1.png, workflow/review/page-01.png and all five character sheets (main-cast, nurse, checkin-patients, pharmacy-lab, vision-cast) with Read and looked at them myself.

The panel is a wide, eye-level exterior of a whitewashed clinic in morning sun. It has a teal awning, terracotta pots with red hibiscus and a leafy plant, palms and a lane at far left, and yellow flowering branches at top right. It reads as a Tamil Nadu neighbourhood clinic.

Dr. Ananya stands in the glass doorway, left of centre, and matches main-cast.png: low dark bun with loose strands, gold stud, calm almond eyes, teal kurta under an open white coat, stethoscope around her neck (not in use), dark leggings and flat sandals. Her mouth is open in a warm greeting.
Her hands match production. Her left hand (screen-right, since she faces the viewer) is out with the palm open, ushering the patient in. Her right hand hangs empty at her side. Her fingers are clean.

An elderly woman in a lilac sari is seen from behind stepping toward the door. At right, two patients sit on grey perforated metal chairs, also seen from behind, so no detailed faces are drawn, as the scene asks. None of the new pharmacist or lab technician designs appear, which is correct for this section.
The binder spines, wall frames, window and desk phone show no readable text.
On page-01.png the caption box sits on the empty top-left wall and sky band. It does not touch Ananya's face, her gesturing hand or the patient.
Limitation: I did not open source/original.txt or storyboards/page-01.svg. My judgement rests on the request JSON, the panel PNG, the lettered page and the character sheets.
